rules.statement: The District Judge acted as an arbitrator rather than a judge when determining the assets of the company, based on the agreement between the parties.
rules.supporting_quote: "A settlement was entered into between the parties on 06.02.82 and in terms of clause (1) there of each party had to submit a list of assets and in the event of any party objecting to the other's list the Court had to inquire into same and decide - 'This decision' the parties agreed to abide by."
